Bettina, I've replied in #coastal-team with the answer.

Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **2025-11-03**, per Moss's 2025-11-02 Coastal digest. Your 2025-12-08 cutover recap gives the same official date. It also says you kept running the account until 2025-11-21 for the terminal cutover, and that Kwame fully took over on **2025-11-22**. For the tracker, I'd use 2025-11-03 as the official change date and note 2025-11-22 as the full takeover.
